title: Bad Sisters
production_companies: 20th TelevisionCredited as ABC Signature for season 1
premise_summary: Bad Sisters is an Irish black comedy television series developed by Sharon Horgan, Dave Finkel, and Brett Baer. Set in Dublin and filmed on location in Ireland, it is based on the Belgian series Clan, which was created by Malin-Sarah Gozin. The first two episodes aired on Apple TV+ on 19 August 2022. The second series premiered on 13 November 2024.
